shared_elements: row of repeated vertical elements (human figures / crew strokes)
linear registers stacked one above another
justification: Both surfaces organise content into horizontal registers with a series of repeated upright strokes/figures in a row, and A's procession of men can loosely echo B's line of crew-marks above a hull, but this is a generic device rather than a shared motif. A depicts naturalistic, modelled human figures in profile with garments, caps, hands and carried vessels facing a seated/standing figure, while B shows only abstract, schematic outline boats with curled prows and dots, with no human anatomy, objects or interaction between figures.
